name: Feature request
about: Propose a change to an authorized document workflow
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

Describe the document format, protection layer, and current limitation.

## Proposed behavior

Describe inputs, outputs, failure behavior, and safety constraints.

## Verification

Describe the synthetic data and tests that could establish correct behavior.

The proposal must not require rights-management bypasses, signature
impersonation, document exploits, or confidential documents.
